## String Slicing
1. Set a variable to hold the string "aaa-bbb_ccc".
1. Using string slicing syntax ("#" and/or "%"):
    i. Write a command that uses the variable to print "aaa".
    i. Write a command that uses the variable to print "ccc".
    i. Write a set of commands that uses the variable to print "bbb".
1. Repeat i-iii using positional slicing syntax (":").
1. Share both a screenshot and your relevant `$ history` with your instructor.

## Building Strings
<!-- alpha="abcdefg"
int=${alpha#*d}
e=${int%f*}
echo ${e}${alpha#*f}${alpha#*f} -->
1. Write a series of commands that use the string "abcdefg" to print "egg" using "#" and "%" slicing methods.
1. Repeat 1, with positional slicing methods.
1. Send the syntax and screenshot to your instructor.
